quests.title: [PH] Food for the Next Load
quests.text: [PH] Thorga wants provisions for the next load to the front: bring 5 Ember Eel. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft TH1; the Throng's capital share of the 41-50 pattern.

quests.title: [PH] Ready at the Water Depot
quests.text: [PH] Thorga wants a prepared load for the front checked and released at the cook court's water depot. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft TH2: the town place of Gor Drazhak's cook court (chapter 1's, another object and label).

quests.title: [PH] A Fang Through the Strap
quests.text: [PH] Thorga wants Siegepack Fangs as proof of what straps and gear must stand up to; the Siegepack Hyenas of the {name:front_shattered_line/trenches} carry them: bring 3. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft TH3 (K7 A): the item only, no kill count (a mob drop: still a fight); Gor Drazhak's weapon (a solo quest). The Sinkmire Viper hunt, a camp hunt's role, is gone.

quests.title: [PH] Optional: Krait Season
quests.text: [PH] Thorga posts a bounty on the Kraits of the {name:front_stormscale_summit/scorchlands} on Stormscale Summit, by day; coin, no leveling. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: An island bounty: coin, no leveling.
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft TH4 (K9 A): the Throng's island bounty, another mob than the Accord's (the check: glass_fang_serpent reads 'Krait' on Stormscale); weight 0, copper like the Accord's.

quests.title: [PH] Party: The Last Offering
quests.text: [PH] Thorga asks for a party against {name:last_offering_ape} on Stormscale Summit; optional, nothing needs it. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: An island bounty: coin, no leveling.
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft TH5 (K9 A): the bounty's one follow-up, the island elite (a recorded exception: the island elites stay per faction, plan §2 point 4).

quests.title: Optional: Sink the Wages
quests.text: There is branded pay in the wreck at {name:r20_anchor_086} on Stormscale Summit, waiting for a salvage crew to call it wages. Take a boat from the Shipwright and give the wreck's pay to the sea before anyone accepts it. The sea already has the sailors; it can keep their money too.

objectives.label: Give the wreck's pay to the sea

quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft TH6: the optional island use, free from 60 without a story prerequisite.
